adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, feed item content is processed as `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and then passed into `TopicEmbed.import(...)`. `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` unchanged for `:raw_html` (skipping the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline). The embed view then renders `raw post.cooked`. This means HTML entities in feeds (e.g. `<script>`) are decoded into live tags before being stored/rendered, enabling injection/XSS via feed content.
